world_org_meetings.title: Search under way for four soldiers missing after gang attack in Haiti
world_org_meetings.description: The UN Security Council holds a meeting on Haiti; the attack on UN-backed forces is expected to dominate the discussions.

world_org_meetings.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelensky hails "real leaders" in Europe, blasts Trump's diesel deal with Russia
world_org_meetings.description: Ukrainian ​President Volodymyr Zelensky took aim on Friday at US President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's stance a "parody" of peace negotiations. At a European Union summit in Brussels, Zelenskiy said Russia did not want peace. He added that Ukraine was still experiencing disruptions to the SpaceX Starshield satellite system. FRANCE 24's Europe Editor Armen Georgian reports from Brussels.

world_org_meetings.title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders meeting in Brussels will examine measures to curb the bloc's huge trade deficit with China. But they will also be looking to further agreement on the next EU budget ahead of some major elections next year.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
world_org_meetings.description: Officials meet in Thailand as conflict drives energy prices higher and casts uncertainty over global economy.

diplomatic_visits.title: King praises Strait of Hormuz peace efforts at glittering banquet
diplomatic_visits.description: The Sultan of Oman, leader of a Middle Eastern strategic partner, is welcomed to Windsor for a state visit.

diplomatic_visits.title: France's decades-long ties with Gulf states built on 'economic development, oil, defence agreements'
diplomatic_visits.description: Genie Godula is pleased to welcome François Gouyette, former French ambassador to the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Against a backdrop of violent unrest at home and escalating conflict in the Middle East, French President Emmanuel Macron's Gulf diplomacy underscores the increasingly blurred boundaries between domestic economic security and international strategic commitments. Ambassador Gouyette argues that the visit serves a dual purpose: alleviating France's energy pressures while reaffirming its longstanding defense partnerships with Gulf monarchies. Insisting that "France has to play its role as a key partner," Gouyette portrays French military assistance as an expression of strategic solidarity rather than direct participation in the war with Iran.

diplomatic_visits.title: France's Macron begins state visit to Qatar as part of wider Gulf tour
diplomatic_visits.description: Qatar welcomed the French president with full state honours on his arrival in Doha as the two countries are strengthening their strategic ties. Facing protests at home, Macron is seeking energy deals with Gulf partners to help ease fuel prices in France, but also contributing to regional stability.

diplomatic_visits.title: King Charles welcomes Oman’s Sultan Haitham for state visit to UK
diplomatic_visits.description: King Charles III and Queen Camilla, joined by Prince William and Princess Catherine, have welcomed Oman’s Sultan Haitham bin Tarik to Windsor at the start of a three-day state visit.

diplomatic_visits.title: Uzbekistan's $12bn business drive gathers pace during Rubio visit
diplomatic_visits.description: The package covers railways, critical minerals, finance and technology, with major US firms involved. Uzbek President Mirziyoyev outlined measures to attract investors, while business executives told Euronews that commercial activity is growing.

elections.title: Alberta's decisive decision to stay in Canada gives Carney backing to take on Trump
elections.description: The overwhelming vote by Alberta to stay in Canada gives Mark Carney political capital to focus on remaking the country's economy, writes the BBC's Lyse Doucet.

elections.title: Cornell Jane Doe says embattled university head doubted her gang-rape allegation
elections.description: As a no-confidence vote looms, Cornell says the characterisation of the head's reaction is "incorrect".

elections.title: Why Israeli Gen Z voters are drawn to the far right
elections.description: More than half a million young people will cast their ballots in Israel next week - and they could make all the difference.

elections.title: Meta tells Brazil's electoral court it treats Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro equally ahead of Sunday vote

elections.title: Bosnian Serb authorities boost neighboring Serbia's populist leader ahead of a key election
elections.description: Serbia's populist leader Aleksandar Vucic faces a key parliamentary election this weekend
